statement: For finite Fq, nontrivial multiplicative χ:Fq*→C* and nontrivial additive ψ:Fq→C*, G=Σx≠0 χ(x)ψ(x) satisfies |G|²=q.
verification_status: Source inspected and finite-sum proof independently reconstructed; no issue found.
hypotheses: Characters have finite image, hence unit magnitude.
proof: Substitute x=uy in |G|²; the inner additive sum over y≠0 is q−1 for u=1 and −1 otherwise. Multiplicative orthogonality gives q.

statement: For X0 smooth projective over Fq and ℓ≠char Fq, det(tI−F | H^i_et(X0×Fq Fqbar,Qℓ)) has coefficients in Z independent of ℓ; each complex conjugate α of every root satisfies |α|=q^(i/2). F is geometric Frobenius.
verification_status: Exact theorem and selected dependency architecture inspected; whole proof not independently audited.

statement: Let U0⊂P1/Fq be the complement of finitely many closed points, F0 a lisse Qℓ-sheaf, β∈Z. Assume a perfect alternating pairing F0⊗F0→Qℓ(−β); the geometric monodromy image is open in the corresponding symplectic group; and det(1−tFx|F0,x)∈Q[t] for every closed x. Then F0 is pointwise pure of weight β.
verification_status: Statement and positivity/pole argument inspected; underlying cohomology and invariant-theory results not independently proved.
hypotheses: Geometric monodromy, not merely arithmetic self-duality.
Rational local characteristic polynomials for every closed point.

statement: For middle eigenvalue α on a smooth projective absolutely irreducible d-dimensional variety, a dimension-independent q^(d/2±1/2) estimate on even-dimensional cartesian powers gives q^(d/2−1/(2k))≤|α|≤q^(d/2+1/(2k)) and hence |α|=q^(d/2).
verification_status: Elementary power/Künneth inference checked; geometric derivation of weak estimate not fully audited.

statement: For f:X→Y between separated noetherian algebraic spaces of finite type over Z with fixed ℓ invertible, and constructible Qℓbar-sheaf F mixed of weights ≤n, R^i f! F is mixed of weights ≤n+i.
verification_status: Original statement and reduction architecture inspected; full proof not audited.

statement: Over Fq, Hc^i(X,F) has weights ≤n+i for F mixed of weights ≤n. On smooth X0 and lisse F0 of weights ≥n, H^i has weights ≥n+i. For F0 lisse pure weight n, im(Hc^i→H^i) is pure weight n+i.
verification_status: Hypotheses and use of opposite duality bounds inspected; no whole-proof audit.

statement: For X0 smooth proper over Fq and ℓ≠char Fq, the characteristic polynomial of geometric Frobenius on H^i_et(X,Qℓ) is integral and ℓ-independent; all complex eigenvalue conjugates have magnitude q^(i/2).
verification_status: Source statement inspected; extension proper vs projective checked.

statement: For X0/Fq smooth curve and F0 lisse iota-pure of weight β, every Frobenius eigenvalue α on Hc^1(X,F) satisfies wq(α)<β+2, wq(α)=2log_q|iota(α)|.
verification_status: Statement/image and Hadamard–de la Vallée-Poussin connection inspected; complete representation-theoretic proof not audited.

statement: For every k≥0, smooth U0/Fq and F0 lisse iota-pure weight0, eigenvalues α on Hc^1(U,F) satisfy wq(α)≤1+2^(−k). Passing to the limit supplies the optimal upper weight bound; duality then yields curve purity in the proper intermediate-extension statement.
verification_status: Exact statement and product-iteration architecture inspected; all local calculations not independently audited.

statement: Z*(t)=(1−5t+5t²)/((1−t)(1−5t)) has integral Taylor coefficients, nonnegative integer Euler exponents in every degree, genus-one reciprocal functional equation, and a finite alternating-duality trace model, but numerator eigenvalues (5±sqrt5)/2 have magnitudes unequal to sqrt5.
verification_status: Explicit all-degree labeled-graph proof reconstructed; parent independently checked injection, exact periods and recurrence. No literature novelty claim.
status: established auxiliary negative result; not a counterexample to any actual curve theorem or classical RH

statement: For ℓ≠5, geometric Frobenius A=[[2,1],[1,3]] defines a continuous Gal(F5bar/F5) representation pulled back to A1/F5. It has a perfect alternating pairing to Qℓ(−1) and rational local characteristic polynomials but is not pure of weight1; geometric monodromy is trivial. L(A1,V^⊗2k,t)=det(1−5t A^⊗2k)^−1.
verification_status: Parent independently checked continuity, geometric/arithmetic Frobenius convention and pole formula; no issue found.
role: Tests deletion of the open-geometric-monodromy hypothesis; not a contradiction to Deligne.

statement: If q>1, α≠0, and for arbitrarily large k, q^(kw/2−Ck)≤|α|^k≤q^(kw/2+Ck) with Ck=o(k), then |α|=q^(w/2).
verification_status: Independent logarithm/division proof; abstraction of DeligneI(7.3), no novelty claim.

statement: For affine U0⊂P1/Fq and lisse F0 with perfect alternating pairing to Qℓ(−β) and rational local characteristic polynomials, suppose for arbitrarily large k all Frobenius eigenvalues on (V^⊗2k)_geometric-monodromy are algebraic and every conjugate has magnitude ≤q^(kβ+Ck), Ck≥0, Ck=o(k). Then F0 is pointwise pure weightβ.
verification_status: Proof reconstruction supplied; separate review of coefficient-field descent and local/global radius comparison pending. Do not assign literature novelty.
